text:
tess: Customer reported inconsistent vector lengths from /v1/rerank: most responses 1536 but ~5% come back 1535. Happened after a burst of batched requests. Need repro artifacts (curl, request IDs, server logs). Can eng triage? :thinking_face:
jamal: thanks — any request_ids yet? also which client lib + gz header?
tess: request_ids: rq_20260317_9f2a1e, rq_20260317_9f2a4, rq_20260317_9f2b0. Client is Python requests sending gzipped body (Content-Encoding: gzip). Sample curl I used for repro below (redacted token):
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" \
  --data-binary @payload.json
```
payload.json is an array of 8 items, each with { "query": "...", "candidates": [...] }.
ingrid: can you also include the exact byte-length of the gzipped payload and the original JSON size? gzip stream framing can cause off-by-one bugs in some clients.
tess: gzipped size 14236 bytes, uncompressed 27540 bytes. Also seeing 400-level spikes in logs around the same time: snippet below (anonymized):
```
[2026-03-17T12:02:14Z] INFO request=rq_20260317_9f2a1e path=/v1/rerank status=200 time_ms=48 tokens_in=320 tokens_out=1536
[2026-03-17T12:02:14Z] WARN request=rq_20260317_9f2a1e path=/v1/rerank validation=embedding_length_mismatch expected=1536 got=1535
[2026-03-17T12:02:16Z] INFO request=rq_20260317_9f2a4 path=/v1/rerank status=200 time_ms=52 tokens_in=224 tokens_out=1536
[2026-03-17T12:02:16Z] WARN request=rq_20260317_9f2a4 path=/v1/rerank validation=embedding_length_mismatch expected=1536 got=1535
```
ben: curious — do the mismatch rows always show got=1535 or vary? if consistent maybe an off-by-one in padding/kv-cache truncation. can you attach the raw base64 outputs for two examples?
tess: attaching base64 snippets for rq_20260317_9f2a1e and rq_20260317_9f2a4 in a debug bundle I uploaded to the support S3 bucket: s3://redwood-debug/support/triage/1977770000_bundle.tar.gz (limited TTL).
support-bot: debug bundle created: support-bundles/1977770000_bundle.tar.gz, size 4.9MB — includes raw responses, server logs, and the exact request bodies.
jamal: ok I'll pull the bundle. Quick checklist while I look: 1) reproduce with non-gz client, 2) reproduce with single-item payloads (no batching), 3) run on dedicated infra if available, 4) capture server-side kernel selection logs (arch/kernel routes).
ingrid: +1 to single-item test. Also try forcing model variant v1.2 vs v1.2-quant to see if quantization path causes length flip.
ben: if you can reproduce locally, please run the binary with env REDWOOD_DEBUG_KV=true and paste the last 20 lines of KV cache ops. small KV truncation bug would show there.
tess: ack — starting experiments now. I'll post results here. If I don't post within 2h tag @jamal @ingrid so we don't lose SLA. :alarm_clock:
jamal: thanks — once you have a minimal curl repro we can escalate to runtime team and open a short-term guard (reject batch sizes >1 for that client) if needed. :thumbsup:
